# Happy New Fallout 76 Year 2025!

## I wish you a happy new year in 2025!

Thank you for your support this year and in 2025 in the form of **donations, video clicks, website views, premium subscriptions, merchandising purchases**, etc! This will help you advance the Nuka Knights project and develop even more interesting features!

You make all of this possible and I already have lots of new plans for 2025!

Thank you for the generated image MonaLisa J!
